desc:
💥 Punch, throw, blast and crash ragdolls all over a whole city. Every hit is real physics!
⭐ NEW: Levels! Earn EXP for everything you do and unlock new gear as you level up.
🎟️ CODES: CITY = +500 EXP, BOOM = free Nuke Strike! Open the Menu → Codes.
🧰 Over 70 gears: slaps, bats, swords, launchers, the Railgun and many more.
🎁 Daily gifts, a 7-day streak, quests and badges to chase.
🚙 Drive the jeep or the dune buggy, smash through buildings, then reset the map.
🪂 Jump off the 240-stud Parachute Tower and open your chute!

Can't wait for a gear? Most can be unlocked early in the SHOP.
Your Level, gear and purchases save for your next visit.
